content.what_it_is: Nine-line MATLAB script plotting grid convergence for the solitary-wave-on-plane-beach statistics benchmark. Hardcodes grid spacings dx=[0.125 0.25 0.5 1.0 2.0] (L1) and corresponding setup maxima hm=[0.672 0.662 0.6412 0.605 0.539] (L2, presumably transcribed from runs), takes hmg=-gradient(hm) (L3) and log-log plots hmg vs dx with black circles (L5); commented axis limits (L6); labels 'dx (m)' and 'Difference in setup (m)' (L8-9).
calls: gradient @L3; clf @L4; loglog @L5; grid @L7; xlabel @L8; ylabel @L9
unresolved: The hm values are hardcoded run results (source runs not referenced); gradient() uses unit spacing rather than the non-uniform dx, so hmg is the raw successive-difference estimate, not d(hm)/d(dx) -- acceptable for the qualitative 'difference in setup' label but not a true derivative.
